{{Short description|Canadian arachnologist}}
'''Nadine Dupérré''' is a Canadian [[Arachnology|arachnologist]] and scientific illustrator. She is a known for her scientific illustrations and has been involved in numerous taxonomic revisions of spiders.

== Biography ==
Nadine Dupérré was born and raised in [[Montreal|Montreal, Quebec]]. She completed her undergraduate studies in biology at the [[Université de Montréal|Université of Montréal]] in biology. After graduation she worked on beetle biodiversity and ecology in Québec boreal forests with Dr. Pierre Paquin. During this work, they also collected over 25,000 spiders, and in 1999, they took the spider identification class from Fred Coyle and Bill Shear in North Carolina<ref>{{Cite web |title=AMERICAN ARACHNOLOGY: The Newsletter of the American Arachnological Society |url=https://www.americanarachnology.org/fileadmin/documents/am_arachnol_newsletter/AmerArachnol45_April_1992.pdf |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=www.americanarachnology.org |archive-date=2022-12-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221225132052/http://www.americanarachnology.org/fileadmin/documents/am_arachnol_newsletter/AmerArachnol45_April_1992.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> to aid in spider identification. In 2003, Paquin and Dupérré published ''Guide d’identification des Araignées du Québec'', a comprehensive guide to identify all spider species in Quebec.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |title=Nadine Dupérré {{!}} Invertebrate Zoology |url=http://research.amnh.org/iz/staff/nadine-dup%C3%A9rr%C3%A9 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20110108190623/http://research.amnh.org/iz/staff/nadine-dup%C3%A9rr%C3%A9 |archive-date=2011-01-08 |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=research.amnh.org |language=en}}</ref>

Dupérré worked as a free-lance arachnologist and illustrator for more than 10 years, completing contracts for government agencies and researchers. She was the principal illustrator for ''Spiders of North America: An identification manual,'' published in 2005, as a guide to all spider families and genera in North America. Dupérré was responsible for over 2000 original taxonomic illustrations. In 2008, she began working at the [[American Museum of Natural History]], where she was served as an assistant to [[Norman I. Platnick]] and participated in the Oonopid Spider Planetary Biodiversity Inventory (PBI) project.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Planetary Biodiversity Inventory: The Spider Family Oonopidae |url=http://research.amnh.org/oonopidae/projectdescription/investigatorsdetails.php?investigatorid=32 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090102033738/http://research.amnh.org/oonopidae/projectdescription/investigatorsdetails.php?investigatorid=32 |archive-date=2009-01-02 |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=research.amnh.org}}</ref><ref name=":0" /> Currently, Dupérré is a researcher at the Arachnida and Myriapoda Research Center of the [[Leibniz Association|Leibniz Institute]] for the Analysis of Biodiversity Change (LIB) in [[Hamburg|Hamburg, Germany]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Nadine Dupérré – LIB |url=https://leibniz-lib.de/en/about-the-lib/employees/nadine-duperre.html |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=leibniz-lib.de |language=en |archive-date=2025-10-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251017052609/https://leibniz-lib.de/en/about-the-lib/employees/nadine-duperre.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

In 2025, she was featured in The Museum Makers exhibition at LIB.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Untold stories: Nadine Duperre – Museum der Natur Hamburg |url=https://hamburg.leibniz-lib.de/en/events/untold-stories-nadine-duperre.html |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=hamburg.leibniz-lib.de}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=The Museum Makers – Museum der Natur Hamburg |url=https://hamburg.leibniz-lib.de/en/exhibitions/special-exhibitions/the-museum-makers.html |access-date=2025-10-28 |website=hamburg.leibniz-lib.de |archive-date=2025-11-07 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20251107005046/https://hamburg.leibniz-lib.de/en/exhibitions/special-exhibitions/the-museum-makers.html |url-status=live }}</ref>

Dupérré, N. (2015) Descriptions of twelve new species of ochyroceratids (Araneae, Ochyroceratidae) from mainland Ecuador. ''Zootaxa'', 3956 (4), 451–475. https://doi.org/10.11646/zootaxa.3956.4.1
